headline: Current selective assistant extraction is too broad and blocks scaling, but the attributable regression magnitude should be caveated.

blockers_to_scaling.summary: The selective gate is effectively broad extraction: 488 assistant turns extracted and only 36 skipped, roughly 93% pass-through.
blockers_to_scaling.impact: The gate is not selective enough to run heldout_50 because assistant facts can crowd out user/gold facts.

blockers_to_scaling.summary: At least one clean attributable regression, 6e984302, dropped gold from top-k after assistant extraction.
blockers_to_scaling.impact: Assistant-origin facts need source-aware retrieval isolation or budgets so they cannot displace user facts.

blockers_to_scaling.summary: Durable-dispatch attempts failed before materialization with non-deterministic orchestration errors.
blockers_to_scaling.impact: Durable must be treated as a separate latent blocker before any Durable heldout_50 run.

interpretation_caveats: The headline 7/10 versus 10/10 overstates the attributable extraction regression; gpt4_70e84552_abs had zero facts in both baseline and selective, so it is likely judge or abstention noise.
The mixed run's one assistant case was already correct in baseline, so assistant-origin mechanism gain is supported by the earlier 6-case assistant slice, not this mixed slice.
This servicebus run is acceptable for quality/noise diagnosis but dispatch differs from the durable prefrefine baseline.
The selective arm is unreplicated while the prefrefine baseline was repeated successfully.
recommended_next_slice: Do not run heldout_50 with the current broad selective gate.
Implement source-aware retrieval isolation or assistant-fact budgets so assistant-origin facts cannot crowd out user/gold facts.
Tighten the assistant gate so it is high precision instead of roughly 93% pass-through.
Run a replicated mixed regression/noise slice after isolation/tightening.
Handle gpt4_70e84552_abs separately as an abstention/judge issue rather than an assistant-extraction signal.
